title: Installing Solver for decisionAccelerator
author: Mark Edmonds
content:
decisionAccelerator is an add-in to Excel and requires Solver (a Microsoft Excel Add-in). If Solver is not installed, it is very common to get the following error when launching decisionAccelerator:

Solver

Check if Solver is installed as follows:

  • Open Excel (not decisionAccelerator)

Open Excel (not decisionAccelerator)

  • File > Options > Add-ins Solver will be listed in the "Active Application Add-ins" if it is installed

File > Options > Add-ins

  • Solver will be listed in the "Active Application Add-ins" if it is installed

Solver will be listed in the "Active Application Add-ins" if it is installed

  • If Solver is not installed Click Go… (next to Excel Add-ins) Check the Solver Add-In Click OK and wait for it to install -- if it is checked Exit Excel

If Solver is not installed

  • Click Go… (next to Excel Add-ins)

Click Go… (next to Excel Add-ins)

  • Check the Solver Add-In

Check the Solver Add-In

  • Click OK and wait for it to install -- if it is checked

Click OK and wait for it to install -- if it is checked

  • Exit Excel

Exit Excel

  • If Solver is installed Click Go… (next to Excel Add-ins) Uncheck Solver Click OK Exit Excel Now follow the steps in Step 3 to re-install Solver

If Solver is installed

  • Click Go… (next to Excel Add-ins) Uncheck Solver

Click Go… (next to Excel Add-ins)

  • Uncheck Solver

Uncheck Solver

  • Click OK

Click OK

  • Exit Excel

Exit Excel

  • Now follow the steps in Step 3 to re-install Solver

Now follow the steps in Step 3 to re-install Solver
